title: Ouster channel results summary
scope: Frozen Dur360 primary test: 16 scans, 60 in-region Vehicle annotations and five repeats. Panel (a) shows the mean of per-run ratios; panel (b) shows the four qualifying BEV matches in the first repeat. No new inference was performed.
attribution: Underlying original Dur360BEV-Extended data: TomEeee / Durham University, CC-BY-4.0 as declared by publisher; project-produced diagnostic plot.
limitations: Not an official benchmark or independent-drive acceptance result. Four matches are annotations across scans, not necessarily unique physical vehicles.
